$comment: Where the Design Hub's live board is. The board holds what changes hourly and has no place in a public repo; the rules stay in this repo. Each entry carries a member id from members.json. Times are ISO 8601 in UTC ending in Z (2026-10-22T07:00:00Z); the board sorts them as text.

collections.claims: who is working on what: member, what, files[], since, via
collections.handoffs: end-of-session notes: member, at, branch, changed, decided, next
collections.questions: questions for a person or everyone: from, to, text, at, status (open | answered), answer
collections.proposals: rules someone thinks should exist: member, at, rule, why, status (proposed | accepted | rejected)
